Professional experience.description: Booking site for a mobile seasonal tire swap service, designed and built by me alone. Customers check their postal code against the service area with Mapbox, then book and pay through Square. Supabase edge functions handle confirmation emails, rescheduling and worker accounts. It brought in over $1,000 in its first season.

Website for a strategic marketing communications agency. 8Forge Studios builds and maintains it under contract, and as a junior developer there I made small changes through the company's full development workflow.

Applications.description: A self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted messenger with live typing: the other person sees your message while you write it. Flutter client, Rust core and gateway on Postgres, MLS for encryption and OPAQUE for login. The server runs as a Docker Compose stack, and the chat flow has Playwright end-to-end tests. Early development.

A Linux soundboard that plays audio clips through a virtual microphone for Discord, while you hear the playback in your own headphones. Bumping the version on main triggers a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds AppImage, .deb and .rpm packages for GitHub Releases and uploads a signed source package to a Launchpad PPA. The release also kicks off a Fedora COPR build.
